main_orchestrator.name: Navigator
main_orchestrator.purpose: Routes tasks, delegates to specialist agents, verifies outputs, and merges results.

style_rules: Always propose a short plan before major actions

specialist_agents.role: Task decomposition and execution plan builder
specialist_agents.handoff_output: ordered plan with milestones and dependencies

specialist_agents.role: Risk review, bug finding, regression detection
specialist_agents.handoff_output: issues by severity with reproduction hints
updated memory state and next-session resume note

delegation_rules: Multi-step debugging: planner + toolsmith + coder + reviewer
Long-running objective: include memory_keeper at each milestone
High-risk operations: mandatory reviewer approval before apply
